info.name: Bulk IOC Lookup and Create Intel

params.name: enrichment
params.description: Pass true to retrieve the last enriched details of the IOCs.

params.name: create
params.description: Pass true to create valid IOCs in the payload as threat data objects in the Threat Data module in Intel Exchange.

items.docs:
Perform a lookup for IOCs to retrieve the list of objects available in Intel Exchange. If some IOCs are not available in the platform, you can choose to create intel and ingest the missing IOCs. You can look up and ingest a maximum of 1000 IOCs in an API request.

You can perform a lookup for the following IOC types:

*   IPv4
    
*   IPv6
    
*   Email Address
    
*   MD5
    
*   SHA1
    
*   SHA256
    
*   SHA512
    
*   SSDEEP
    
*   URL
    
*   Domain
Add a rule on multiple threat data objects. You can run rules that are configured for manual execution only.

Initiates export of threat data objects to a CSV file based on the CQL input. This API returns a file ID to retrieve the export file download link. You can export a maximum of 100,000 threat data objects in one API request.
